title: Grateful Dead Live at Saenger Performing Arts Center on 1982-09-09
source: Recording Info: Beyer M160 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-C90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16; Recorded by Frank Streeter; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Lively audience tape captures a high‑energy Samson & Delilah and Feel Like a Stranger, with crisp early‑set sound but a puzzling setlist flow.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source that sounds surprisingly clear on the first half of the show and delivers a raucous, “coked‑up” vibe on Samson & Delilah and Feel Like a Stranger. While fans rave about the energy, one reviewer finds the unusual placement of Samson after Uncle John's confusing, giving the set a mixed feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers rate the show/recording highly (4 stars) praising energy and sound quality; one reviewer rates it zero due to setlist oddity, leading to a mixed but generally positive overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early songs described as crystal‑clear; audience tape praised for liveliness and overall good balance, no major dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual sandwich of Samson & Delilah after Uncle John's Band noted as odd, but overall set remains high‑energy and engaging.
